case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and for the openness in explaining your costs. We value the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both.

Two points need to be clarified first:

Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

With this in mind, we have prepared options for you. They differ in price and payment terms, so you can choose the one that suits your company best:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 126.89; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 123.18; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 125.46; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.

We hope one of these works for you and look forward to continuing our partnership.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. For our revised offer, we can propose a price of €137.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €134.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days. 

Please note that our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. It is always a pleasure working with your team, and we look forward to continuing our long-standing relationship.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Option C: unit price EUR 126.81; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.

Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. As to the index change and price history data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. While we acknowledge the labour cost index data, our overall production costs have risen significantly more over this period. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

To continue our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to build on your Option C and offer a further reduced price of €136.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your revised offer and the continued trust in our family foundry. We deeply value the decades of shared history and partnership between Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and our house.

To help close the remaining gap, we are making a further concession and can offer €134.80 per unit based on your Option C with 30 days payment terms. For complete clarity, our offer is a price of €134.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This proposal remains valid for 7 days.

We believe this represents a fair compromise that respects both our long-standing relationship and our operational realities. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
